Pico thin adapter (LAW-NO-SELF-BUILD):
- Keep upstream file layout: MEMORY.md / SCRATCHPAD.md / daily / notes.
- PI_MEMORY_DIR is membership-scoped (Pico sets it). Never share ~/.pi/agent/memory.
- Drop TUI dashboard, Last-24h LLM summary, git autocommit, session scanner.
- RPC has no pi-tui; compact notify is a no-op without ctx.hasUI.
- Do not invent a vector Memory OS.
